newsitem.title: USA: Miami telemarketers settle FTC charge.
newsitem.headline: Miami telemarketers settle FTC charge.

text.p: The Federal Trade Commission said on Wednesday that a Miami telemarketing couple settled a fraud charge for $1 million and a stipulation that the two post a $100,000 bond before doing any more telemarketing.
It said the alleged scam was run by Michael Chierico and his wife, Teri Chierico, using different company names centering on office products and business supplies.
The FTC alleged the firms used a variety of deceptive practices to sell copy machine toner.

It alleged the couple would misrepresent themselves as a firm's regular supplier of toner and then sell them additional overpriced toner; but when the firm reordered, the couple allegedly said the past bills were overdue.
The FTC said the defendants then used threats to ruin the firms' credit or to take legal action to collect the charges.
It said the $1 million would be used for consumer refunds.
